texture_overrides_note: Composio's signature is a near-black #0f0f0f canvas carrying white type with a single deep-electric-blue voltage (#0007cd) reserved for CTAs and spotlight glows; abcDiatype substitutes to Inter at -0.022 tracking per the brand's own font note. The literal #0007cd / #1a26ff blue is too dark on #0f0f0f to clear the contrast floor, so the accent is brightened to #4f8bff (5.91:1 on canvas, clears the 4.5 floor) while staying unmistakably Composio electric-blue rather than cyan. Halation 0.07 lets that blue bloom on the accented decorator line for the WOW halation-glow check; lighting_arc 0.28 gives CLASSIC its color drift; grain 0.05 plus vignette 0.22 hold the dark technical atmosphere. Blue is scarce: the @mcp.tool decorator line and the close accent only.
